name: implement-plan
description: Hands-free implementation of an agreed plan — splits the work into worktrees and cheap-model executors, checks every slice against the plan item by item on the premium model, runs an adversarial review (installed skills or an on-the-spot panel), fixes what it finds, keeps technical decisions logged and functional ones for the user, and never deletes a worktree or leaves a gate without a one-word resume.
